@ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 (single-thread WebAssembly distribution) — GPL-2.0-or-later
The unmodified npm WASM binary is split into two transport chunks and reassembled
byte-for-byte before use. JavaScript loader is unmodified.
Licenses: COPYING.GPLv2, COPYING.GPLv3
Corresponding build scripts, FFmpeg source version and dependency revisions:
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/71aa99d37c02a7b4c435275ca9ef50e612f6efa1
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/v12.15/build
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n5.1.4
FFmpeg includes third-party codecs such as x264; see the pinned build scripts for
all component source revisions and license terms. No warranty. The component
license governs this independently distributed executable engine.
